description: Visual and gameplay polish, extensibility hooks for future phases, and full documentation. Adds lighting/shadows/skybox quality, drift/skid feedback, reset behavior refinement, and a README covering how to run (offline-aware) and how to play. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: Polish lighting and environment in src/engine/renderer.js / a new src/game/environment.js: a directional 'sun' light with shadow camera framed to the track, ambient/hemisphere fill light, a procedural gradient/skybox (THREE.Scene.background via a large sky dome or gradient shader / equirect-free gradient texture generated on a canvas so it needs no network asset), subtle fog matched to sky color, and tone mapping (ACESFilmic) + sRGB output. Ensure the car and barriers cast/receive shadows.

Add drift/skid feedback in src/game/car.js: detect lateral slip (compare velocity direction vs chassis forward, or wheel skid from the raycast vehicle) and when drifting/handbraking, spawn tire skid marks (decals/quads on the road) and/or a simple particle/emissive puff, and tilt/lean the car body slightly for arcade feel. Keep it lightweight and pooled so it does not leak objects. All thresholds from CONFIG.handling.

Refine reset/respawn: R during RACING returns the car to the last passed checkpoint (position + heading, zeroed velocity) rather than the global spawn, so a spin-out is recoverable; R on FINISHED restarts the whole race (re-run countdown). Confirm controls remain locked during countdown.

Add extensibility hooks so later phases layer cleanly without refactors: define a lightweight system registry in the game loop (e.g. an array of {update(dt, ctx), render(alpha, ctx)} systems) and document how an OpponentAI system, AudioSystem, Minimap, and additional cars would register. Add a src/systems/README or top-of-file comments describing the extension contract. Do NOT implement AI/sound/minimap now, just the seams.

Write README.md at workspace root: project overview; EXACT run instructions emphasizing NO install/build is needed and offering three ways to serve (`python3 -m http.server 8080`, `npx serve`, or `npm start` -> node scripts/serve.mjs) then open http://localhost:8080; explain the importmap/CDN approach and that an internet connection is required the first time the browser loads Three.js/Cannon-es from jsDelivr; document the sandbox/offline note (why it could not be rendered headless here); CONTROLS section (W/Up throttle, S/Down brake-reverse, A/D or Left/Right steer, Space handbrake/drift, R reset/restart); a 'Tuning' section pointing at src/config.js; an architecture/directory overview; and a 'Roadmap / Phase 2+' section listing opponent AI, sound, minimap, multiple cars, upgrades and how the system-registry seams support them. No em dashes anywhere.
Add a .gitignore (node_modules, logs, .DS_Store, editor dirs) even though there are no deps, so the tree is clean if the user later runs npm.
Final self-check: run scripts/check.mjs and node --test and ensure everything is green.
acceptance_criteria: `node scripts/check.mjs` exits 0 and `node --test test/` passes all tests after polish changes

renderer/environment configures shadows, a procedurally generated (no-network) skybox/gradient background, fog, and ACESFilmic tone mapping; car and barriers cast/receive shadows (verifiable structurally)
car.js implements drift detection tied to CONFIG.handling and spawns pooled skid feedback; R resets to last checkpoint during race and restarts on finish
README.md exists with exact run instructions (no install needed), the CDN/offline note, a CONTROLS section, a Tuning section pointing at src/config.js, and a Phase 2+ roadmap; contains no em dashes
A system/extension seam exists in the loop with documented contract for future AI/audio/minimap systems
verification: Serve with scripts/serve.mjs and confirm GET / returns 200
Grep README.md to confirm CONTROLS, Tuning, and Roadmap sections exist and confirm no em dash character is present
findings:
Implemented all FEAT-004 scope. New modules: src/game/environment.js (procedural canvas-gradient sky dome + BackSide sphere, framed-shadow directional sun, hemisphere + ambient fill, fog recoloured to sky horizon; renderer.js now uses ACESFilmic tone mapping + configurable exposure, sRGB already set). src/game/skidmarks.js (fixed-size pooled skid-quad decals, round-robin recycle, opacity fade over lifetime, clear() on reset). src/game/logic/drift.js (PURE lateralSlip/isDrifting/driftIntensity, unit tested). car.js: added inner bodyGroup for arcade lean, canvas radial-sprite smoke puff, drift detection each step spawning pooled marks under rear wheels by travel-distance spacing, and _resetDriftFeedback. New CONFIG.environment block and CONFIG.handling skid tunables. raceState.js: added lastPassedGateIndex + lastCheckpointPose getters; main.js R mid-race respawns at last checkpoint (respawnAt helper), R on finish restarts; buildLighting replaced by buildEnvironment. loop.js: added systems registry (addSystem/removeSystem, ordered update after core update and render after core render, shared context) documented in src/systems/README.md and loop header. README.md rewritten with run options, importmap/CDN + offline note, Controls, Tuning, architecture, Roadmap. .gitignore expanded with logs + editor dirs. Verified: check.mjs exit 0; node --test = 43 pass (26 baseline + 17 new: drift, systems, respawn); static serve GET / = 200; no em dashes anywhere. Note: 3D scene not renderable headless in-sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, no browser/CDN) as expected; verified structurally. Node run with env -u NODE_OPTIONS per env quirk.

Post-review polish pass (2026-09-20 review, 3 actionable non-blocking issues addressed): (1) Respawn offset: lastCheckpointPose in raceState.js now nudges the recovery pose back along -forward so a mid-race R no longer drops the car straddling the gate line. Added CONFIG.track.spawnBackOffset (6 m) as the single source for the offset and routed both the grid spawn in track.js _computeSpawn and the checkpoint respawn through it. Updated test/respawn.test.js expectations to the offset positions (gate 0 -> z=-6, gate 2 -> z=56, gate 3 -> x=56); tests still exercise the real getters and fail if reverted. (2) Removed the redundant pre-step this.sync() from Car.update and rewrote its doc comment to state the update -> physics.step -> sync contract explicitly; confirmed main.js still calls car.sync() after physics.step(dt). (3) Moved the hard-coded coasting rolling-resistance brakeForce = 2 into CONFIG.handling.coastBrakeForce and read it from car.js, keeping config.js the single source of truth. Issue 4 (headless render verification) is environmental and was not attempted per INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (no browser/CDN in-sandbox), as noted by the reviewer. Re-verified: check.mjs exit 0; node --test = 43 pass; static serve GET / = 200; grep for em dashes = none.
